input.selection: all O1.14 states with at least one nonzero 100 ms short-gate probe

handoff_basin_size.scope: conditional on the O1.14 37-state candidate layer, not all frozen P3

cross_phase_note.interpretation: Bank 996 does not reproduce strict feasibility under the O1.15 population-64 x 10 one-stage search. This does not withdraw O1.12, which used a population-128 x 20 two-stage handoff plus post-axis stabilization search; it demonstrates search-budget and parameterization sensitivity.

interpretation: This is a practical long-horizon CEM estimate inside the O1.14 candidate layer. It does not estimate the full P3 measure and cannot modify O0. Existence, terminal height recovery, and clone reproducibility are reported separately to avoid promoting one lucky rollout as a basin.
